title: ExecutionResult
description: Returned by await() or poll() (ADR-0003 §4). A non-zero exit code is a result, not an error: a failing test is the normal case in a repair loop. The error taxonomy is reserved for the executor failing to run the command at all.

exitCode.description: Present when status is COMPLETED. Non-zero is a normal outcome and does not by itself fail a node.

stdoutPreview.description: Bounded inline preview for human display only. The full stream is always in stdoutRef; ADR-0003 §4 forbids returning output inline beyond a preview.

networkDenials.description: Connections refused by the network policy. ADR-0003: a security and supply-chain signal worth alerting on, not merely debug output.
